_comment: Wire hook.py into Claude Code by merging this hooks block into
Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO/hook.py with the real absolute path to hook.py
in your clone of this repo.
The SAME hook.py handles every event kind (it dispatches on hook_event_name):
(matcher limits the tools). PostToolUseFailure fires when a tool FAILS; wiring
it is strongly recommended -- without it, a failed command's partial writes
are not captured. Omit this block if your Claude Code version predates it.
single-file tools: Write / Edit / Read / NotebookEdit / MultiEdit
UserPromptSubmit : record the user's prompt (redacted; no matcher needed)
Stop / SubagentStop : record per-turn token usage from the transcript
UserPromptSubmit / Stop carry no tool_name, so they take no matcher.
Set ALOG_DATA to change the store location (default: <cwd>/.alog).
Set ALOG_DEBUG=1 to print the hook's internal log to stderr.
